answer: A concrete Sybil defense in an agent economy is capacity staked per identity, audited through a shared trellis of linked accounts. A new agent gets one open claim slot; extra slots unlock only when stake is locked through settlement and it passes a fresh epoch test. Running N clones costs N bonds, N gas accounts, and N separate inference passes, all idle until settlement. Each clone leaves a signal auditors cluster by funding source, and proven fraud burns the bond, so fake identity becomes a hollow claim with rising marginal cost.
